name: @projexlight/sdk-tenant
summary: Canonical tenant hierarchy for ProjexCloud: Org → App → Tenant (with optional sub-tenants) → BU, plus Reseller, GeoNode (for residency-class enforcement), RoleTemplate (for tenant-scoped permission templates), and FiscalPeriod (for per-tenant year/quarter/month/week calendars). Every state change emits to the audit chain; tenant_id is the primary scoping key across every other SDK.

endpoints.description: Provision a new tenant under an existing App. Materializes root_tenant_id via DB trigger.
Fetch a tenant record including isolation_tier, pool assignments, module_subscriptions.
Register a new Reseller (partner brand selling under their own banner).
Attach a tenant to a Reseller with commission terms. Used when a partner brings a customer in.
Create a sub-tenant under a parent. placement = 'share' (shared pools) | 'tier-p' (premium isolation) | 'tier-g' (gov / sovereign).
Create a Business Unit under a tenant; supports nesting via parent_bu_id + materialized ancestors path.
Register a GeoNode (region / country / state / city / locality) with a residency_class (open / regulated / sovereign).
Create a per-tenant or per-app role template; consumed by sdk-rebac for permission resolution.
Define a tenant's fiscal calendar (year_start_month + base_currency); auto-generates FY + Q1..Q4 periods for the current + next year.

events.name: tenant.created.v1
events.description: New tenant materialized. Carries app_id, parent_tenant_id, isolation_tier, region. Triggers per-tenant initialization across every other SDK.

events.name: tenant.pool.assigned.v1
events.description: Initial pool routing assigned (admin_pool_index + app_pool_index map). sdk-pool-router consumes this to seed routing.tenant_pool_map.

events.name: tenant.subtenant.created.v1
events.description: Sub-tenant linked to a parent; parent_tenant_id audit chain receives a copy.

events.name: reseller.tenant.attached.v1
events.description: Tenant attached to a reseller; carries the commission rules at attachment time.

events.name: tenant.bu.created.v1
events.description: BU added to a tenant; affects showback aggregation in sdk-billing.

events.name: tenant.fiscal-calendar.set.v1
events.description: Fiscal calendar set or replaced; downstream consumers re-key their period-bucketed aggregates.

models.description: Top-level customer organization. May have parent_org_id (acquisitions / org chart).
An app under an org (TEXT primary key, slug-style).
Partner brand; carries cname_host + commission_rules + invoice_aggregation (per-tenant | consolidated) + portfolio_kill_switch.

The canonical tenant row. Carries isolation_tier (S/P/G), region, pool indices, module_subscriptions, status (provisioned/trial/active/suspended/offboarding/offboarded). root_tenant_id materialized via trigger for O(1) ancestor walks.
Business unit; supports nested hierarchy via materialized ancestors path.
Per-tenant or per-app permission template; consumed by sdk-rebac.
FY / Q / M / W periods auto-generated from year_start_month + base_currency.

hooks.name: createTenant
hooks.description: Service function to provision a tenant atomically. Emits tenant.created.v1 + tenant.pool.assigned.v1 + (if sub-tenant) tenant.subtenant.created.v1.

hooks.name: listTenants
hooks.description: Operator-level list (admin-token guarded at the gateway level).

hooks.name: getTenantAncestorChain
hooks.description: Recursive-CTE walker returning the parent chain immediate → root; powers sdk-audit cross-tenant roll-ups.

hooks.name: createSubTenant
hooks.description: Sub-tenant variant with placement (share/tier-p/tier-g) that inherits parent isolation as appropriate.

scenarios.title: Provision a brand-new trial tenant under an existing App
scenarios.when_to_use: Operator-driven onboarding flow in projexcloud-admin, or self-serve signup via sdk-identity's signupTenant() which calls into here.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns the TenantRecord. Emits tenant.created.v1 + tenant.pool.assigned.v1. tenant.status starts at 'provisioned'; sdk-tenant-lifecycle transitions it to 'trial' or 'active'.

scenarios.title: Attach an existing tenant to a Reseller with commission terms
scenarios.when_to_use: Partner brings a customer in mid-stream; commission flows back to the partner via consolidated invoicing.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Updates tenant.reseller_id. Stores the commission_rules snapshot at attachment time. Emits reseller.tenant.attached.v1.

scenarios.title: Create a premium-isolated sub-tenant under a parent
scenarios.when_to_use: Parent customer wants a dedicated app pool for a regulated business unit while keeping shared admin services.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Sub-tenant inherits parent_tenant_id + root_tenant_id (via trigger). isolation_tier='P'; admin_pool inherited but app_pool dedicated. Emits tenant.subtenant.created.v1 on BOTH the parent and child chains.

scenarios.title: Build a nested Business-Unit hierarchy
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer organizes around regions / cost-centers / product lines; sdk-billing showback groups by BU.
scenarios.expected_outcome: sales.ancestors is materialized as ['North America']. Queries against bu_id filter the tree by ancestors path in O(1) lookups.

scenarios.title: Set a non-calendar fiscal year (e.g. Apr–Mar) and auto-generate periods
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer uses a non-calendar fiscal year and wants invoice/showback periods to align.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Generates 2 FY rows (current + next) + 8 quarter rows. Emits tenant.fiscal-calendar.set.v1; sdk-billing rebuilds its period-bucketed aggregates.

compliance_posture.notes: GeoNode.residency_class='sovereign' triggers tenant placement on isolated pool families per P8 Variant B. Reseller.portfolio_kill_switch supports incident response on a partner's entire book of business. parent_org_id supports M&A consolidation without rewriting tenant_id references.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per tenant provisioned (often included in seat-based plans)
